title: Transcript of a Conversation Between a Customized AI and Human Users
descriptions: The dataset contains transcripts of conversations between a customized AI and human users, with each utterance represented as an entry. Each entry includes a sequential identifier (Seq), the session interval (Interval), a timestamp (TimeCode), the speaker (Speaker), the conversation text (Contents), an initial progression score (Progression Score), the AI's response (ChatGPT4), any noted discrepancies (discrepancy), and a finalized progression score (Progression_Score_finalized). This dataset is valuable for analyzing human-AI interactions, evaluating the AI's performance, and identifying discrepancies in responses.
